commands.author: ZengWen-DT

target.title: fix(qqbot): resolve start() when abort signal already fired
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where stopping the QQBot gateway during or immediately after startup could leave `GatewayConnection.start()` pending forever when the caller AbortSignal was already aborted. The previous lifecycle also continued connecting after an early abort, which could leave a socket created during shutdown outside cleanup ownership.

## Why This Change Was Made

`start()` registered abort listeners after work had already begun without normalizing an already-fired signal. The fix makes abort handling idempotent at registration, skips connection work for pre-aborted starts, and checks lifecycle ownership after each asynchronous startup stage. A socket created after an in-flight abort is closed before it can be adopted. Risk is limited to the QQBot connection startup and shutdown path; no config or protocol surface changes.

## User Impact

QQBot channel stop/restart no longer hangs when shutdown overlaps startup, and startup does not retain a WebSocket that finishes opening after its lifecycle owner has stopped.

## Evidence

**Live configured-account proof (redacted):**

```
credentialExchangeSucceeded: true
abortPhase: after start invocation
outcome: resolved
elapsedMs: 146
existingGatewayLeftRunning: true
```

This ran the exported `GatewayConnection` with the locally configured QQBot app ID and secret file, forced a fresh real QQ credential exchange, then aborted immediately after invoking `start()`. The patched lifecycle resolved in 146 ms after the real credential request and stopped before gateway URL/socket adoption. The already-running live Gateway was left online, and no messages were sent.

**Deterministic before proof on the original implementation:**

```
label: before-fix
timedOut: true
elapsedMs: 501
resolved: false
exit: 1
```

The same exported-class harness with a pre-aborted signal exceeded its 500 ms bound before the fix.

**Focused regression tests:**

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/qqbot/src/engine/gateway/gateway-connection.test.ts
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests       9 passed (9)
```

Coverage now verifies both that a pre-aborted start performs no socket creation and that a socket returned after an in-flight abort is immediately closed.

**Additional checks:**

```
$ pnpm format extensions/qqbot/src/engine/gateway/gateway-connection.ts extensions/qqbot/src/engine/gateway/gateway-connection.test.ts
Finished on 2 files

$ git diff --check
# clean
```

`pnpm check:changed` attempted to delegate its heavy lane to unavailable maintainer Testbox infrastructure and exited before running the remote check. Full type/lint/build gates are therefore left to GitHub Actions. A full active-service restart was not performed because it would disrupt the existing live channel.

AI-assisted: Codex and Cursor; proof runs executed on this machine.
